name: relay-voip-node
description: RELAY mediasoup media-node agent. Runs ON a media node, NOT on the app fleet. Deliberately a separate package: the app is bundled with esbuild --packages=external and each app instance runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` on every deploy, so a root mediasoup dependency would make every app box compile a C++ worker it never runs.
comment_pins: EXACT versions, not ranges. The two live nodes were installed at mediasoup 3.19.3; a fresh `pnpm install` against ^3.19.3 today resolves to 3.23.2, so the range alone meant a rebuilt node would silently differ from the running ones by four minor versions — and the C++ worker is compiled per install, so nothing would surface the difference until a call behaved differently on one box. mediasoup's own API has moved inside that range (listenIps and announcedIp are @deprecated in favour of listenInfos and announcedAddress), which is exactly the kind of drift a range hides.
